response.sql: SELECT AVG(g.avg_band) AS avg_of_group_avg_bandusage, AVG(g.n_telescopes * 1.0) AS avg_of_group_counts FROM (SELECT o.observstation, o.weathprofile, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_band, COUNT(*) AS n_telescopes FROM telescopes t JOIN observatories o ON o.observstation = t.observstation WHERE t.pointaccarc >= 4.86 GROUP BY o.observstation, o.weathprofile) g

assumptions.assumption: The number of telescopes in each group is the count of all telescopes in the group (COUNT(*)), including those with a missing bandusagepct; only the average ignores missing values.
Telescopes with NULL pointaccarc are excluded because they do not satisfy the >= 4.86 condition.
